summary: Added a recognizable rocket engine, XZ/XY views and up to three labeled proposed microphones with independently predicted levels, matching spectra and report records. 165 tests and five analytical benchmarks pass; standalone builds are deterministic. Desktop/mobile, controls, state reload, HTTP standalone and actual local-origin offline recovery were verified. Imported PDFs, the original example study and owner flight-response files are preserved.
limitations: Preliminary empirical predictions; no measured engine/pad correlation or qualification.
Direct-file/import automation, reset dialog and print preview were not repeated; earlier owner-observed import remains separate.
Actual download delivery was not repeated; report/JSON/SVG content was verified locally. Spectrum CSV remains M1 only.
next_steps: Review the live tool at http://localhost:4178/#/tool/nasa-sp8072 and enter the intended engine parameters and proposed microphone coordinates.
